{{History}}

[[File:Small Wondrous Mount Bag.png|thumbnail|right|Small Wondrous Mount Bag]]

* '''Acquired from:''' [[Keep on the Borderlands Bonus Items]]
* '''Binding:''' {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}
* '''Unique Item Capacity:''' 6
* '''Stack size:''' 100
* '''Weight:''' 0.01 lbs
* '''Description:''' A small enchanted bag that can holder wondrous mounts.
* '''Notes:''' This item was rendered useless with the mount changes in U48, as mounts are no longer kept in the inventory. Those owning one were credited with a [[Large Ingredients Bag]], which also replaced it in the Keep on the Borderlands Bonus Items pack in the store. Characters created before U48 may still possess one, but if so, it is worthless, and can be safely sold or discarded (check it's empty of mounts first!)
